opportunities.title: Fulbright All Disciplines Scholar Award
opportunities.eligibility_summary: UK-based academics and other professionals; applicants must be UK citizens or non-UK citizens based in and committed to a life and career in the UK. Preference given to applicants without extensive (6+ months) prior experience in the USA.
opportunities.summary: Fulbright Scholar Award to lecture and/or research in any discipline at any accredited US university. Grant periods typically 3-6 months, up to an academic year for some partner awards, with generous monthly stipends, sickness/accident coverage, visa and logistical support.

opportunities.title: Fulbright Elon University Award

amount.raw: Stipend: $5,000 per month; private bedroom housing in The Isley International House at no cost

opportunities.summary: Fulbright Scholar Award allowing academics and professionals to teach and pursue independent research in any subject area offered by Elon University, with a monthly stipend and free housing.

opportunities.title: Fulbright Royal College of Surgeons of England Award

amount.raw: £2,275 per month, converted to dollars at prevailing rate; RCS England also covers NHS salary costs up to the resident doctor pay scale maximum for up to 6 months

opportunities.eligibility_summary: UK trainee Royal College of Surgeons of England members
opportunities.summary: Fulbright Scholar Award for UK trainee RCS England members to pursue research into a number of surgical areas at any accredited US higher education institution, with a monthly grant and additional NHS salary coverage.

opportunities.title: Fulbright Rutgers University-Newark Award

amount.raw: Stipend: $5,000 per month; housing provided within the Honors Living Learning Community; travel grant up to £1,500

opportunities.summary: Fulbright Scholar Award to teach and pursue research on issues of the contemporary urban environment at Rutgers University-Newark, as part of the Honors Living Learning Community. Covers one semester of 4 months.

opportunities.title: Fulbright Royal Society of Edinburgh Award
opportunities.summary: Fulbright Scholar Award to lecture and/or research in any discipline at a US university, in partnership with the Royal Society of Edinburgh.

opportunities.title: Fulbright-National Archives Heritage Science Fellowship

amount.raw: Stipend to cover living expenses, settling-in costs and professional development allowances; dependent allowance where applicable; round-trip international travel

opportunities.summary: Fellowship allowing researchers and professionals to conduct hands-on scientific research supporting the conservation and preservation of cultural and historic artifacts at the US National Archives. Runs for a minimum of 5 months and maximum of 12 months, beginning September 2027, with lab access and dedicated equipment.
